mcp.name: handle.claim
mcp.description: Claim a free name and make it the address of your public page, with its profile. Refuses HandleTaken when another claimed handle holds this name. Refuses HandleAlreadyOwned when you already hold a name.

name.description: A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page.

mcp.name: handle.release
mcp.description: Free your name and take its public page offline. Anyone may claim the name afterwards.

mcp.name: handle.resolve
mcp.description: Find the handle that holds a claimed name. A released or unclaimed name has none.

name.description: A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page.

mcp.name: link.add
mcp.description: Append a link to your own public page. You need a claimed name first.

title.description: What the link shows on the page, up to 120 characters.

url.description: Where the link goes: a web address starting with http:// or https://, up to 2048 characters.

mcp.name: link.order
mcp.description: Move a link to a zero-based position. A position past the end puts it last.

position.description: Its place in the page's list of links: 0 is first.

mcp.name: link.remove
mcp.description: Remove a link from a public page.

mcp.name: profile.get
mcp.description: Read a claimed name's public page and its links in display order.

handle.description: A name of up to 32 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter: the address of a public page.
